main_result.name: QFORM-NEARCOLOOP-PIVOTFREE-PROJECTED-CUT-v1
main_result.statement_short: In the exact-rank-three true-near-coloop chamber with hub mass c>63/64, delta=1-c>0, leaf transverse leverage <1/64, and D=|det Lambda|, one can choose an original-coordinate leaf partition satisfying every grouped-crossing row gate and obtain ||p_Q||_inf <16.61 (c delta D^2)^(-1/6). The branch has a continuous C0 density.
main_result.exact_currency: For any positive cut, S^2 Z_2 = c D^2 det(G_J) det(T_I), where S is the hub-to-J crossing singular value, Z_2 is the projected light-crossing 2-volume, G_J is the full 3D leaf Gram on J, and T_I is the transverse 2D Gram on I.
main_result.partition: Bernoulli I-probability 2/5 yields some cut with det(T_I)det(G_J)>=kappa_0 delta, kappa_0=1647/50000. Since det G_J<=delta, lambda_min(T_I)>=kappa_0 and every rank-two volume row marginal is <50000/(64*1647)=0.4743473<1/2.
main_result.mechanism: Apply the independently checked one-hub, ell=2 grouped projected-crossing theorem to the actual original-source cut. No arbitrary-joint coarea or projected independence is used.

combined_bound: For a!=0 in the same chamber: ||p_Q||_inf <= min(4 sqrt(2e)c^(-1/2)(|a|D)^(-1/4), 16.61(c delta D^2)^(-1/6)). At a=0 designated partner account02/B16 r36 gives <7.6.
partner_application: account02/B16 r36: at a=0 write Q=2b sqrt(c)X0 U+2bSU+uU^2+2vUV+wV^2; take H=X0,L=U,T=bS,gamma=b sqrt(c),kappa=w and M_(U,V)<=2. Since det Lambda=-b^2w, ||p_Q||_inf<=3*2^(4/3)(cD)^(-1/3)<7.6.
